categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in functional materials and their application products, including functional adhesive films, new energy coated carbon foil, flexible flat cables (FFC), and LED flexible circuit boards. It focuses on new materials for electronics, new energy, and energy-saving environmental protection sectors, serving industries such as 3C electronics, new energy vehicles, energy storage, semiconductors, and home appliances.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary adhesive formulations, precision coating techniques, low dielectric loss hot melt adhesive films, and environmentally friendly coating technologies. The company also develops advanced manufacturing processes such as physical cutting for LED flexible circuit boards, ultra-thin coating for carbon foil, and nanomaterial dispersion for carbon nanotube conductive pastes. It emphasizes R&D in high-frequency, high-speed transmission materials and automotive-grade high-temperature resistant films.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the 3C electronics sector (printers, TVs, computers), new energy vehicle manufacturers, energy storage battery producers, semiconductor manufacturers, and home appliance companies. Major clients include Samsung, Foxconn, Nissan, Great Wall Motors, SAIC-GM-Wuling, and Beijing Automotive. The company also serves downstream customers in lithium battery and LED lighting industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Guangdong, Henan, and Sichuan provinces forming a strategic 'golden triangle' to cover the national market. It actively expands overseas markets including Hong Kong, Taiwan, South Korea, India, Thailand, and Malaysia, focusing on Southeast Asia and India for global business growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and upstream segments of the supply chain. It produces key functional materials such as adhesive films and coated carbon foils used as raw materials for downstream products like flexible cables and battery components. It also extends upstream into nanomaterial production (carbon nanotubes and conductive pastes) to enhance its product portfolio and supply chain integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing new energy materials (carbon nanotubes, coated carbon foils), enhancing high-frequency and high-speed transmission materials, and expanding automotive and energy storage applications. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on innovation in adhesive formulations, coating technologies, and intelligent manufacturing. It fosters industry-academia collaborations and talent development to maintain technological leadership and accelerate product commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of functional adhesive films, flexible flat cables, LED flexible circuit boards, and new energy coated carbon foils. The company employs a direct sales model primarily, supplemented by buyout distribution channels. It also earns income from providing processing services and exports products internationally, with some government subsidies contributing to other income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically in functional adhesive films and related materials, breaking international monopolies held by Japanese and Korean firms. It competes with global leaders in high-frequency transmission materials and new energy battery materials. Its diversified product portfolio and technological advantages position it strongly in the emerging new energy and electronics materials markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 438.2 million, a 7.9% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 29.25 million, down 38.66%. Total assets reached RMB 1.176 billion, growing 3.2%, with net assets of RMB 1.006 billion, up 4.19%. Despite recent revenue decline due to market conditions, the company maintains stable growth with ongoing capacity expansion and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technological innovation, product quality, and environmental sustainability as its core value propositions. Its products feature superior performance in high-frequency transmission, high-temperature resistance, and environmental compliance (RoHS, no halogen). Unique manufacturing processes like physical cutting for LED boards and precision coating technologies differentiate its offerings. The company also leverages integrated product solutions combining coated carbon foils, carbon nanotubes, and functional films to meet evolving customer needs in new energy and electronics sectors.
